title: Set 148

sentences.ko: 오늘 회의에서 데이브가 내 슬라이드를 자기 것처럼 발표했거든. 나중에 그 얘기를 꺼냈더니 내가 쪼잔하게 군다는 식으로 나오더라. 그러기 전까지는 그렇게 화나지도 않았는데!
sentences.text: So Dave presented my slides in the meeting today like they were his, and when I brought it up after, he acted like I was being petty. I wasn't even that mad until he did that!

alts.text: Dave basically passed off my slides as his in today's meeting, and when I called him on it later he made me out to be petty. I wasn't even that mad till he did that!
Dave presented my slides in today's meeting as though they were his own, and when I raised the matter afterward, he behaved as if I were being petty. I was not particularly upset until he did that!

sentences.note: **brought it up** 은 어떤 이야기를 꺼내다라는 뜻이에요. **petty** 는 사소한 일로 쩨쩨하게 구는 것을 말해요.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 모퉁이에 있는 그 카페, 원래 내가 제일 좋아하던 데였거든. 근데 주인이 바뀌고 나서 온통 비싸고 화려한 음료뿐이고 앉을 자리도 없어서 이제 잘 안 가.
sentences.text: That coffee place on the corner used to be my favorite, but they got new owners, and now it's all fancy drinks and there's nowhere to sit, so I don't really go anymore.

alts.text: I used to love the coffee spot on the corner, but new owners took over and now it's all fancy drinks and no seats, so I kinda stopped going.
The coffee shop on the corner used to be my favorite, but it has new owners, and now it offers mostly elaborate drinks and has no seating, so I rarely go there anymore.

sentences.note: **used to** 는 예전에는 그랬지만 지금은 아니라는 뜻이에요. **it's all fancy drinks** 처럼 it's all 뒤에 명사를 붙이면 온통 그것뿐이라는 말이 돼요.

sentences.ko: 너네 애들도 올해 숙제 엄청 많아? 우리 애는 겨우 4학년인데 어떤 날은 밤 9시까지 숙제하고 있어. 솔직히 반은 나도 못 도와줘.
sentences.text: Are your kids getting a ton of homework this year too? Mine's only in fourth grade, and she's up till nine some nights, and honestly I can't even help with half of it.

alts.text: Your kids buried in homework this year too? Mine's just in fourth grade and some nights she's up till nine, and honestly I can't even help with half of it.
Are your children also receiving a great deal of homework this year? My daughter is only in fourth grade, yet some nights she is up until nine, and frankly, I cannot help with half of it.

sentences.note: **a ton of** 는 엄청 많은이라는 뜻의 구어예요. **up till nine** 은 9시까지 안 자고 있다는 말인데, 여기서는 그때까지 숙제를 붙들고 있다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 너네 강아지 봐 주고 싶어, 진짜로. 근데 우리 집주인이 반려동물에 엄청 깐깐해서, 알게 되면 나 진짜 곤란해질 수도 있어. 너희 언니한테는 물어봤어?
sentences.text: I'd love to watch your dog, I really would, but my landlord's super strict about pets, and if he finds out I could get in real trouble. Have you asked your sister?

alts.text: Man, I wish I could watch your dog, but my landlord's super strict about pets, and I'd be in real trouble if he found out. You ask your sister yet?
I would be glad to look after your dog, truly, but my landlord is very strict about pets, and if he were to find out, I could face serious consequences. Have you asked your sister?

sentences.note: **watch your dog** 에서 watch 는 잠깐 맡아서 돌봐 준다는 뜻이에요. **get in real trouble** 은 진짜 곤란해지다, 큰일 나다라는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 주말에 이것저것 계획을 잔뜩 세워 놨는데, 결국 늦잠 자고 소파에 누워서 책만 읽었어. 근데 있잖아, 몇 주 만에 컨디션이 제일 좋아.
sentences.text: I had all these plans for the weekend, but I ended up just sleeping in and lying on the couch with a book, and you know what? I feel better than I have in weeks.

alts.text: So much for my weekend plans. I just slept in and curled up on the couch with a book, and you know what? I feel better than I have in weeks.
I had made a number of plans for the weekend, but I ultimately slept late and spent the time on the couch with a book, and I must say, I feel better than I have in weeks.

sentences.note: **ended up** 은 결국 ~하게 되다라는 뜻이에요. **sleeping in** 은 늦잠 자다, **better than I have in weeks** 는 몇 주 만에 가장 좋다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

reviewed: 3번 한국어: 4학년 아이가 9시까지 숙제를 붙들고 있다는 뜻인데 '안 자고'가 붙어 늦게까지 안 자는 얘기처럼 읽혀서 고침. note 도 이 자리의 뜻에 맞게 고침
4번 한국어: '너희 개'가 친구끼리 하는 말로는 딱딱해서 '너네 강아지'로 고침
5번 한국어: '몸이 제일 개운해'가 feel better 보다 좁고 어색해서 '컨디션이 제일 좋아'로 고침
